entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Urano Teixeira da Matta Bacellar was a Brazilian military man. He was born in Bagé, in the state of Rio Grande do Sul. He served for 39 years in the Brazilian Army and eventually rose to the rank of Lieutenant-General. He was married and had two children.
